notes.subject: לא ידע אל
notes.rationale: Subject ambiguity: 'man El i no save long em' (one whom El does not know) vs 'man i no save long El' (one who does not know El); most versions take man as subject, YLT takes El as subject.

notes.subject: man
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin needs 'man' (relative clause head) that Hebrew leaves implicit in the verb.

notes.subject: ol Miskan
notes.rationale: משכנות kept as Miskan per discipline, not 'haus' alone.

translation: Tru, ol dispela em ol Miskan bilong man nogut, na dispela em ples bilong man ⟨את⟩ El i no save long ⟨em⟩.
